title: Constructible modules are finite constructible complex hearts
statement: For any scheme X [def-pc-scheme], with the fixed small-site universe [def-weil-size-convention], and any commutative condensed coefficient ring Λ on profinite sets, every finite constant scalar-model constructible internal Λ_X-module [sk-def-sfb-constructible] is a finite constructible complex heart [def-sfb-finite-constructible-complex-heart-presentations]: there is a finite-support cochain complex of such constructible modules whose degree-zero homology is isomorphic to it. No finiteness or nonemptiness assumption is imposed on X or Λ.

source.place: Definition finiteConstructibleComplexHearts, specialized to the complex concentrated in degree zero.

proof.text: The zero module admits the zero finite scalar presentation and the identity cover. Its one-stratum stratification is valid even on the empty scheme; affine restriction preserves zero.

Use the single complex with the given constructible module in degree zero. Its other terms are zero, hence constructible. Its support lies in {0}. The canonical singleObjHomologySelfIso identifies its zeroth homology with the given module.

proof_origin.place: Definition finiteConstructibleComplexHearts, specialized to the complex concentrated in degree zero.
